summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Personal Growth & LifeOS MVP. Backend: 100% pass rate (58/58 tests). Frontend: All major features tested and working correctly including Daily Focus (1-3-5 tasks, goals, milestones, rollover, timer), Growth Hub (trackers, workouts, backlog), Weekly Review (4-step wizard), and Settings.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog overlay can block subsequent interactions if not properly closed
ui_bugs.details: The 'Add to Growth Hub' dialog overlay remained open and blocked clicks on other elements. Resolved by pressing Escape key, but suggests dialogs may need better auto-close or escape handling.
